purpose: Current-source paired validation screen for the prediction-connected MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate and strong baselines.
research_question: Does the frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-fusion candidate remain competitive with RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 under one current-source H96 contract?
architecture: MambaTSv3 uses one shared Mamba-1 patch scan; the AutoCon representation is connected to the forecast through a zero-initialized low-rank temporal residual. The representation objective remains train-only.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics or predictions are generated. This screen is not a held-out release.
claim_boundary: This matrix cannot establish universal forecasting, causal AutoCon attribution, long-horizon superiority, or hardware-independent speed.

required_before_launch: verify four dataset hashes and exact 72-job expansion
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The candidate fusion, AutoCon lambda, baseline model set, optimizer and budget are fixed before launch; no dataset-specific model or hyperparameter selection is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the AutoCon objective and prediction-connected representation fusion; baselines remain plain forecasting models.
capacity_fairness_contract.resource_boundary: Runtime and memory are reported separately from accuracy and measured with a fixed synthetic forward contract.

phases.name: candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen prediction-connected MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate on four current-source H96 datasets.

phases.name: baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Current-source strong baseline context on the identical four H96 datasets and seeds.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report paired validation deltas only within this current-source matrix. A held-out test release requires a separate immutable plan and approval.

stopping_rules: Stop a dataset branch for any publication claim if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not claim AutoCon causal gain without an exact lambda-zero mechanism screen.
Do not convert validation results into test claims or release predictions.
prelaunch_gates: verify four dataset hashes and exact 72-job expansion
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root
